# CrushSVG Complete Platform Documentation & Specifications

Website: https://www.crushsvg.net
Brand: CrushSVG (Built by The Nevon Studio - https://www.thenevon.com)
License: Free Web Service & REST API

## About CrushSVG
CrushSVG is a developer and designer utility platform for vector image conversion, optimization, and code generation. It solves common rendering bugs in email clients (like Microsoft Outlook dropping SVG support), design software (Figma, Illustrator, Canva), cutting tools (Cricut, Silhouette), and web applications (React, Next.js, WordPress, Shopify).

## Key Features & Conversion Pipeline

1. SVG to PNG Conversion:
   - High-fidelity rasterization using Canvas API and SVG rendering engine.
   - Scale factor options: 1x, 2x (Retina), 4x (4K), 8x, 16x.
   - Preserves CSS styles, embedded base64 fonts, linear/radial gradients, clipping masks, and drop shadows.
   - Transparent background retention with full 32-bit alpha channel.

2. PNG to SVG Vectorization:
   - Image tracing powered by VTracer vector quantization.
   - Color reduction algorithms and bezier curve fitting.
   - Generates clean, scalable `<path>` shapes without artifacts.

3. AI Background Removal:
   - Client-side segmentation powered by vision models.
   - Removes backgrounds from e-commerce product photos, portraits, and logos.
   - Outputs transparent PNG cutouts ready for Amazon, Shopify, Etsy, and eBay listings.

4. Favicon & Web Icons Packaging:
   - Input: Any `.svg` vector file.
   - Output: Multi-resolution `favicon.ico` containing 16x16, 32x32, 48x48 icon layers.
   - Apple Touch Icon (`apple-touch-icon.png` 180x180).
   - Android PWA manifest (`site.webmanifest` & `icon-512.png`).
   - WebP modern browser icons.

5. SVG to Frontend Component Code:
   - Converts SVG markup to React TSX / JSX components with TypeScript interfaces.
   - Supports Vue 3 (`<template>`), Svelte (`<svg>`), Tailwind CSS SVG styling, and React Native (`react-native-svg`).
   - Option to auto-replace fill/stroke hex codes with `currentColor` for dynamic theme coloring.

## Supported Locales & Internationalization
- English (`/`)
- Spanish (`/es`)
- German (`/de`)
- French (`/fr`)
- Portuguese (`/pt`)
- Japanese (`/ja`)

## Security & Data Integrity
- 100% Client-Side In-Browser Execution for standard operations.
- Zero server retention of user uploaded graphics or rendered images.
- HTTPS TLS 1.3 encryption for REST API calls.
